title: Subacute Cough and Fatigue (Synthetic Routine Intake)
intake_statement: Hello, I have had a dry tickling cough for about 3 weeks now. It gets worse at night. I don't have any high fever, no chest pressure, and no difficulty breathing when resting, just annoying coughing and some tiredness.

expected_facts.statement: No chest pressure or severe shortness of breath
